exchangeFormat: KS: RST + 3-char KS county. Non-KS: RST + 2-char state/province, or 'DX'. (KS abbreviation never used.) Bands 80-10m + 6m. Phone/CW/RTTY (worked once each per band). KS works everyone; non-KS works KS only. FT4/8 is a SEPARATE entry/log (not scored here).

scoringRules.scoreFormula: (Σ QSO pts × Σ mults) + bonus. Pts: Phone 2, CW 3, RTTY 3. Each station workable once per Phone / CW / RTTY per band. Mults counted ONCE (not per band, not per mode). KS entrant mult = each US state (50, incl KS via inStateSelfStateMult — 'first KS county logged counts as the KS multiplier') + each Canadian province (13) + 1 DX = 64; KS counties are NOT per-county mults for a KS entrant. Non-KS entrant mult = each KS county (105). KS works everyone; non-KS scores KS contacts only. KS mobile/rover/portable county-change = new QSO + new county; county-line = separate QSO per county. KS0KS = one-time +100 bonus (all stations, also QSO credit). Claimed/running — the KSQP coordinator re-adjudicates. NOT scored here (separate entry/off-log): the FT4/8 grid-square competition (separate log, no multipliers); 1x1 spelling/stamp & Worked-All-KS/Sunflower/Rookie awards.
